question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi item line'
  END AS ORDER_LINE_TYPE,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  SUM(o.SALES_QTY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS,
  AVG(o.SALES_QTY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_LINE_TYPE
ORDER BY 
  CASE ORDER_LINE_TYPE 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Multi item line' THEN 3
  END

action.answer:
In 2025, among orders with at least one item line:

- 1,307,684 orders (29.99%) had exactly one item line ("one-line orders").
- 3,052,089 orders (70.01%) had more than one item line ("multi-line orders").
- No orders were found with zero item lines in the data provided.

Average ordered units per order:
- One-line orders: 1.219753 units per order
- Multi-line orders: 3.484769 units per order

Interpretation: The majority of orders (about 70%) contained multiple item lines, and these multi-line orders had a much higher average number of units ordered per order compared to one-line orders. No orders without item lines were observed in the 2025 data.
